name: claude
title: Claude cross-vendor interface
summary: Adds the Claude-backed half of the Codex-native harness: cross-vendor code review through the Claude CLI, and a Claude counterpart for the ultra-plan planning roundabout.

bin: claude (Claude CLI) — for reviewer-claude and planner-claude
env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an authenticated `claude` login — both agents

notes: Without this pack the harness still gets full fresh-context GPT-5.6 Sol review; it just has no cross-vendor option.
